circuit.cp_rule: blocked capacitance counted exactly once; reciprocal theta signs
circuit.energy_boundary: full declared behavioral stores and assumed losses; not encrypted PMIC internals

firmware.pgood_low_inflight: finish current TX; gate at boot exit or sleep

geometry.beam_source: inherited COMSOL-derived constants; not newly recomputed
geometry.gap_actuation: move stationary product; rotating driver x=.856m fixed

initial_energy.mechanical_state_rule: k*q0 = interpolated F(angle=0,q0); qdot=0; equilibrium preload energy counted

mission.cold_start_gate: receiver stage counts completed timely packets grouped by silence; separate source cold-start mission contract

packet.byte_order: raw bytes in C; cloud can match with two little-endian uint32 IDs

source_trajectory.coordinate_rule: stationary tip x=.856+gap; driver x=.856*cos(a)-.045*sin(a), z=.856*sin(a)+.045*cos(a)-.075265
source_trajectory.electrical_input: none at baseline; controlled input replaces door with F=0, Vin source 6V/20ohm for .3s

units.firmware_input_conversion: upstream dt milliseconds, current milliamps; adapters convert explicitly

version.numerical_semantics: Radau2e-8/1e-13; accepted macro/event ticks; PMIC latches at macro boundaries
